_comment: Which commands of the required sync job (.github/workflows/version-skill-check.yml, job `version-skill-check`) tools/scripts/gates.sh does NOT hand to the lane that reads them from the workflow. Every other `python3 <script>` command in that job is run by gates.sh's `sync-job` lane with CI's own arguments, so adding a step to the workflow adds it to gates.sh with no further edit. `gates_native`: gates.sh runs the command in a block of its own; `gates` are literal fragments that must appear in tools/scripts/gates.sh, and every `--flag` CI passes must appear in them unless listed in `flag_exceptions` with a reason. `ci_only`: CI runner plumbing or a lane gates.sh runs by another path. Keys are the commands exactly as tools/ci/source_selftests.py sync_job_commands() prints them; tools/scripts/test_gates_sync_parity.py fails on a stale key, an unlisted unresolvable command, or a native block gates.sh lost. `diff_scoped`: the only commands gates.sh runs only when the diff can reach them (select_for_changes), each measured over a minute; the rest run every time. `non_python_commands`: repo scripts the job runs that are not `python3 <script>.py`; the lane cannot see these, so each is listed and the test fails on an unlisted one.

flag_exceptions.--ci-warn-only: CI cannot read the private planning repository, so an unverifiable pin ancestry is only a warning there; gates.sh can, and fails closed

ci_only.tools/scripts/ci_diff_base.py --event \": resolves the event's diff base; gates.sh takes its base as an argument and the lane substitutes the merge-base with it
ci_only.tools/ci/source_selftests.py run --min-c: the source-only selftests; gates.sh runs the same manifest diff-scoped in its 7a-src lane (and a gate host reports them NOT CHECKED)
ci_only.tools/ci/source_selftests.py run --manif: runs only when the repo variable PULP_CLASSIFY_WIDE_NON_NATIVE is set, for a tooling-only change that skips the macOS gate

diff_scoped.tools/scripts/test_gates.py: runs gates.sh's lint blocks under bash, about 130s
diff_scoped.tools/scripts/test_version_at_land.py: clones the checkout per fixture, about 160s

non_python_commands.tools/ci/net-retry.sh: installs PyYAML for the wide non-native tier, which runs only when PULP_CLASSIFY_WIDE_NON_NATIVE is set (see ci_only)
